text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaaah--!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye! She claims the Triple Tiara! 
The 5th Triple Tiara winner in history!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
A sweeping sweep from the far outside to 
take a crushing victory! What an utterly 
magnificent burst of speed! Oh, she's 
fast! That was a truly phenomenal 
finishing kick!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are on her next race! Just how 
strong will this Umamusume become?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You won the Shuka Sho too, didn't you, 
Ai-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes you the ultimate rival. 
You're so strong... it's almost 
infuriating.
choice_data_list:
Even so, I could never match the running 
you create.

Even so, it can't match the running that 
you create.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
............ ......Yes. I will create it. 
The ultimate special move.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please watch closely! —Witness the drama 
born of miracles!!
The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, Kiseki-san! Are you really running 
away again?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That'd be more fun, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mmmmm.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: That might make me go a little "grrr."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm one generation ahead of Kiseki-san! 
I've got tons of race experience, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If someone like you is going to strategize 
against me, I couldn't ask for more.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I'm really looking forward to it! 
Right now, I have so many horse girls 
around me who take immense pride in their 
speed.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm gonna pull ahead of all of 
them!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's say goodbye to conventional wisdom. 
Let's go one step beyond what we've ever 
imagined.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right here, I'm going to create a turning 
point in history.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I'll create it. A new era!
